title: Reader Chapter 27
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

examples.title: Ferne circles the rent number twice
examples.scenario: Ferne stops a red pen at Monday 11:06 p.m. in her yellow kitchen table in Trenton, tenant organizer, with the landlord's revised lease. The meeting ended with three neighbors angry at her. Ferne replays it and sees that she spent twenty minutes proving the math while Mrs. Abel was asking whether anyone respected her years in the building. Ferne she writes the three conversations in the margin for next time.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.

examples.title: Imani holds the broken drawer pull
examples.scenario: Imani touches a broken brass drawer pull at Wednesday 7:09 a.m. in the preschool kitchen on Laurel Avenue, center director, with sticky oatmeal bowls in the sink. The snack drawer has been yanked loose for the third time. Imani knows which aide was closing. She also knows the drawer sticks, the morning shift is short, and she delayed the repair request. Imani she must decide whether to blame the aide or map what let the break happen again.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.
